summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 3 to its Fifth Amended and Restated Advisory Agreement with Ashford Inc. and Ashford Hospitality Advisors LLC. The amendment simply extends the negotiation period for revised Base Fee or Incentive Fee through December 31, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; this is a routine contractual extension. The filing does not indicate unusual corporate events or strategic changes. No deal terms, premiums, or material financial impact are disclosed. This is an ordinary contractual amendment, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
